title: pebbles doctor: detect index/file inconsistency
description:
Implement r[index-consistent]: a command (working name: pebbles doctor) that reports and optionally repairs divergence between index.json and issues/ - missing files, orphaned files, unknown index entries. The repo's own database has historically carried orphaned test-pollution files.
